suite: native interrupted metadata upstream applicability review
scope: local inode/producer recovery implementation; final full checks and release/KVM gate remain separate

primary_sources.finding: unnamed staging removes precommit named debris, but its documented named-link/rename commit can still leave a named temporary after abrupt interruption
primary_sources.application: attach a complete inode-bound receipt before naming staging; reconcile only the original pending object instead of deleting by filename

primary_sources.finding: O_TMPFILE stages an unnamed inode, whose data is discarded after the last descriptor closes unless it is linked; the documented /proc/self/fd linkat form can publish it without CAP_DAC_READ_SEARCH
primary_sources.application: stage/sync bytes and xattr on the descriptor, use the pinned parent descriptor and linkat, and require supported local filesystems without a named-file fallback

primary_sources.finding: fsetxattr binds attributes to an open file; XATTR_CREATE refuses an existing attribute
primary_sources.application: store parent, target, mutex, PID/start/boot/namespace/executable and content receipts on the actual staging inode before it is named

primary_sources.finding: flock is attached to an open file description, including inherited duplicates; remote filesystem semantics differ
primary_sources.application: retain per-target permanent mutex inodes; validate their parent/name/actual inode before publication and recovery, and refuse remote filesystem settlement

primary_sources.finding: recovery establishes a complete hot journal and exclusion before repairing prior writes; journal publication/sync precedes mutation
primary_sources.application: apply complete-receipt and exclusion requirements to a single JSON publication; this is metadata roll-forward, with no runtime create replay or inherited power-loss guarantee

primary_sources.finding: delay_enter delays an actual syscall without requiring a fabricated return; --kill-on-exit fences tracees when their tracer exits
primary_sources.application: observe the actual pending inode/xattr and original root binary/PID/start, kill through a pidfd, confirm parent reaping, then restart the unmodified release binary

implemented_boundaries: private local parent descriptor and supported kernel filesystem
complete per-target mutex binding published from an unnamed inode and retained during store lifetime
file bytes and complete bounded xattr receipt synced before the pending name is created
prior content/inode/ctime/receipt digest preimage must match; replacements and links are preserved
recovery requires the same boot/PID namespace/executable and actual original identity absence; an own failed-call retry additionally requires the original kernel mutex
new installation lock cannot be published as an empty partial claim; matching installation bytes are validated before marker recovery
records reconcile independently with unconfirmed targets retained; manager records expose completed/unconfirmed targets
private bootstrap and persistent journals share the publication primitive
not_accepted: release binary syscall-cut and KVM regression until the new gate passes
host power-loss durability inferred from SIGKILL

first_release_gate.observation: 21 completed groups and seven partial manager checks; actual private/native paused recovery authenticates the original generation, but immediate public resume returns invalid_state before new metadata syscall cases execute
first_release_gate.source_diagnosis: store/lifecycle.rs rejects Unknown/other non-live projected states; worker recovery updates that projection independently. The old report has no exact public snapshot at refusal, so a projection race is source-supported rather than directly proven. Expiry was still more than three minutes away.
first_release_gate.fixture_correction: record bounded public projection transitions and require actual Paused/desired Paused before one resume request; do not relax the API state guard or native paused/identity checks
first_release_gate.collection_correction: record native JSON remove replies and independently resample old PID/start/paths after the production manager drain; preserve failed attempts and original test outcome; unparsed/unowned records remain unconfirmed
first_release_gate.gate_order: run the five release-metadata cuts before the retained driver/public baseline; all 37 groups remain required
first_release_gate.compilation_cache: cache completed dependencies on runtime failure; source/build commands and gates are unchanged
